name: CB2_ST_REST
meaning: Update 0: timer 0; -> 1 when a move modifier (MSG_MODIFY_MOVE) arrives (inferred)

name: CB2_ST_SLIDE
meaning: Update 1: slides; magnet contact sound 0x110; the state byte tested by MSG_MAGNET_QUERY (inferred)

name: CB2_ST_SINK
meaning: Update 2: moves down at 100 u/s for one second, then Reset (inferred)
